question_connections.evidence_needed: Appropriately redacted schedules matching assisted-unit designations across funders and programs at the same property.
question_connections.would_clarify: Whether designation counts overlap before any unique assisted-apartment count is reported.

question_connections.evidence_needed: Executed restriction agreements and amendments, with verified start dates and applicable terms.
question_connections.would_clarify: Which affordability restrictions apply and when they end; an authorization alone does not establish expiry.

question_connections.evidence_needed: Project-specific disbursement records matched to the funder, program, phase and reporting period.
question_connections.would_clarify: What was paid, before considering any spending-per-apartment calculation.

question_connections.evidence_needed: A correction, executed agreement or amendment, transaction explanation or closeout record connecting the conflicting dated statements.
question_connections.would_clarify: Whether and how the statements can be reconciled; both sources remain visible until then.

question_connections.evidence_needed: Appropriately redacted City and State HOME unit schedules, and evidence connecting HOME and ARPA set-asides.
question_connections.would_clarify: Whether the six City HOME units, five State HOME units and ARPA designations overlap. No resident identities should be published.

question_connections.evidence_needed: Executed affordability agreements and amendments, including verified restriction start dates and terms.
question_connections.would_clarify: Applicable restriction periods and expiry, without carrying an older authorization term onto changed unit or income statements.

question_connections.evidence_needed: Current deed records and the parcel or legal description for the development.
question_connections.would_clarify: Current deed ownership and property identity. Program and City file identifiers are insufficient.

question_connections.evidence_needed: An executed amendment or other explanatory record connecting the 2023 ARPA authorization to the 2025 performance statement.
question_connections.would_clarify: Why the unit and income statements changed, and which executed terms apply.

question_connections.evidence_needed: City disbursement and loan-balance records, a complete financing stack and evidence of total development cost.
question_connections.would_clarify: Actual payments and financing measures, without relabeling HUD funding fields as independently verified cash disbursements.

question_connections.evidence_needed: A dated occupancy record or inspected certificate-of-occupancy evidence appropriate to the question.
question_connections.would_clarify: What completion and current occupancy can be verified beyond the draft CAPER statement. This would not establish current vacancy availability.

question_connections.evidence_needed: HUD-approved grant Annual Statements/Budgets and the approved five-year plan.
question_connections.would_clarify: Which uses and budget line items were approved for each grant.

question_connections.evidence_needed: Grant-level Performance and Evaluation reports or LOCCS reports.
question_connections.would_clarify: Phoenix PHA obligations, draws and expenditures by grant and activity; missing amounts remain unverified, not zero.

question_connections.evidence_needed: A grant-to-project and City-year reconciliation supported by grant and activity records.
question_connections.would_clarify: Which grant years and activities support the annual SEFA expenditure row. A single award cannot be subtracted from it to infer a balance.

comparisons.title: 25th @ Bell: different ARPA set-aside statements
comparisons.difference: The authorization describes 11 units at or below 65% AMI for at least 20 years. The later report describes 16 units at or below 40% AMI with the same $896,564 allocation.
comparisons.unresolved: An executed amendment has not been verified. The older 20-year authorization term must not be carried onto the changed unit and income statement. Neither record establishes actual payment or a verified restriction expiry.
comparisons.needed: An executed amendment or other explanatory record connecting the authorization to the performance statement.

comparisons.title: Capital Fund: two published 2026 HUD amounts
comparisons.difference: The master ACC amount of $2,842,753 is $28,849 higher than the separate formula amount of $2,813,904. This is arithmetic between published sources, not a verified award-revision transaction.
comparisons.unresolved: The reviewed records do not establish the transaction, date or reason linking these amounts. A file-update label is not a Phoenix transaction date. The difference is not evidence of missing money or a cash receipt.
comparisons.needed: An explanatory transaction or revision record linking the published amounts, alongside grant-level approval and reporting records.

project_details.title: The Moreland
project_details.intro: Two planned phases. Separate financing records. Follow the dates, financial stages and questions that remain open.

phases.title: Phase I
phases.scope_note: The reported closing and the earlier approval ceiling describe financing stages. Neither is verified City cash spending or the total development cost.

phases.title: Phase II
phases.scope_note: The authorization combines funding sources whose split is unverified. Up to 54 vouchers is not a count of executed contracts or additional apartments.

timeline.label: Earlier Council development-scope report
timeline.text: An earlier Council report is one of the sources attached to the published two-phase development-scope finding.

timeline.label: Phase I financing authorization
timeline.text: Council approval allowed up to $50 million. An authorization ceiling is not the reported closing amount or a payment.

timeline.label: Phase I reported financing closing
timeline.text: Phoenix IDA reports $43.1 million of Moreland I financing closed. This is not a City expenditure total.

timeline.label: Phase II assistance and voucher authorization
timeline.text: Council authorized up to $10 million from HOME, NSP and other affordable-housing funds, plus up to 54 project-based vouchers. Execution and the fund split remain unverified.

evidence_needed.title: What was actually paid?
evidence_needed.text: Match project-specific disbursements to the funder, program, phase and period before calculating any spending per apartment.

evidence_needed.title: Which terms were executed?
evidence_needed.text: Executed assistance agreements, fund allocations and voucher records are needed before treating authorizations as paid or contracted assistance.

project_details.limits: The combined 237 apartments describe planned scope across two phases. An older summary labels Phase I with 237; the published research says not to use that as completed Phase I units. No completed-apartment count, current availability, total City spending or comparable cost per apartment is established here.
